title: Create: Ars Compat
description: Simple compatability mod for Create x Ars Nouveau
body:
# Create Ars Nouveau Compat
Add small compatability fixes/additions into Ars Nouveau to work along side with Create.

# Changes
* Mechanical Arm can target the Arcane Pedestal/Platform.  

I plan on adding more features as they're requested or I think of something.
